nodes.label: Taxonomy
nodes.question: What are the three main blocks included in the SAM?
nodes.answer: The three main blocks in the SAM are factors of production, activities and products, and economic institutions.
nodes.paragraph: ( 2022 ). The SAM is based on the 2019 data and represents the mutual interrela - tionships between the production structure, income distribution, and consumption patterns in Nigeria. The accounts included in the SAM are grouped into three main blocks: (a) fac - tors of production, (b) activities and products, (c) economic institutions. In the SAM, two types of production factors are represented: labor and capital. Additionally, the crop produc - tion sector utilizes a third production factor (land), which is considered as a specific type of capital for the sector. The SAM contains 25 sectors and 26 products, including fertilizers, which are entirely imported. Moreover, the agri-food sector is subdivided into four catego - ries: crop production, livestock, fisheries, and processed foods. The economic institutions in the SAM includes an external agent (the rest of the world) and three domestic agents (firms, government, and households). Furthermore, households are categorized regionally, includ - ing 6 geopolitical regions of Nigeria: South-South, South-East, South-West, North-Central, North-East, and North-West.
